notes: Timeline editor minimum width. The full-screen editor no longer shrinks below 1024px wide — if the window is narrower, the editor holds at 1024px and scrolls horizontally instead of cramming its columns. Done with grid-template-columns: minmax(1024px,1fr) + overflow-x:auto on .tl-editor; the old ≤1100px responsive column-shrink was removed so the layout keeps full size right down to the 1024px floor. Applies to both Scene Editor and Timeline layouts.
